bugs.name: HeadOverflowBug
bugs.description: ABI encoder v2 can improperly encode data if calldata strings or bytes arrays are passed to external calls and their length is extremely large.
bugs.exploitability: High if contracts accept unvalidated arrays/strings and pass them to other contracts.
bugs.recommendation: Upgrade to Solidity 0.8.14 or newer. Avoid passing unvalidated large arrays from calldata directly to other external functions.

bugs.name: StorageWriteRemovalBeforeConditional
bugs.description: The Yul optimizer can incorrectly remove storage writes before a conditional branch if the write is considered redundant, leading to incorrect state.
bugs.exploitability: High in complex logic where state variables are updated conditionally.
bugs.recommendation: Upgrade to Solidity 0.8.17 or newer. Disable Yul optimizer if upgrade is not possible.

bugs.name: EmptyByteArrayCopyBug
bugs.description: Copying an empty byte array from memory or calldata to storage can result in data corruption.
bugs.exploitability: Medium. Occurs when dynamic arrays of length 0 are copied to storage.

bugs.name: ZeroStorageDeleteBug
bugs.description: Deleting a struct containing a zero-sized array might not properly clear the remaining fields in some specific configurations.
bugs.exploitability: Low. Requires a struct with a zero-sized array.
